predictions: Well, we finally dumped a match to forfeit this season… sadness. On top of that, last week was a CRAZY mess of random attendance, and it super-torpedoed a bunch of my picks. I ended up with a pretty weak 15-10 for the week, including a bunch of losses in a tiebreaker or the last 501, and a couple from simply shorthanded teams. That hot mess dropped me to 193-92 (67.7% correct) for the season. At least I got both the Main Street Mayhem and Cheap Shots predictions correct.

Match of the week: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Wing & a Plaque. With the three teams chasing them posting a combined record of 3-5 over the last three weeks, Wing is all of a sudden in a spot to start locking teams out of the B title race. Attack absolutely was (and probably still is) the most dangerous chaser, but their 1001 loss to the Kids last week was just crushing. This will be close, but Wing moves onward, 13-11.

Match #2: (C Div.) Pints & Points @ Mulligan's Mafia. The Mafia and the Possee (sounds like some out-west gangland gun fight) are cruising toward a week 14 showdown for the C crown. But before we get to that, the Mafia has to overcome the top "other" team in the standings. Going to be another good one, but this is Mafia, 14-10.

Match #3: (D Div.) Main Street Mayhem @ Bottoms Up. This is the marquee matchup in D, but this pairing has lost a little bit of shine here because the Bottoms were able to overcome attendance issues last week while the Mayhem wasn't. Thus, Mayhem now needs a win here plus some help over the last two weeks. Bottoms end the drama, 13-11.

Match #4: (G Div.) 21 Dart Salute @ She-nanigans. Salute's freefall has reached three straight now, and suddenly they're in this match for third place in G. This is a must-win for She-nanigans if they want to keep their hopes for a top-two finish… and is kind of a must-win for Salute as well. Salute just has to snap out of it, don't they? 14-10.

Match #5: (F Div.) Heart of Dartness @ Nein Mark. Dartness has already mathematically eliminated every other F team in this race, and Nein Mark's chances are hanging by a thread. Nein certainly has the talent to end Dartness's perfect season, but there is just no reason for me to pick anything but a close-but-no-cigar win by Dartness, 13-11.

Match #6: (D Div.) Duck Fook @ Menace 2 Sobriety. If Bottoms Up handles their business tonight, the winner here is immediately in a battle for 2nd in D (and a possible climb to C in the spring). While Duck's 4-win streak is awesome, I'm taking Menace in the last 501.

Match #7: (C Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Liquor Possee. Sure, the Mafia has to face the third place team tonight, but McGavin is no pushover. The Possee better not show up with one of those partial lineups tonight. I think the Possee shows, and moves onward, 15-9.

Match #8: (F Div.) Death Throw @ Sofa Kings. Death Throw has the point lead on Nein Mark, so if Dartness can remain undefeated tonight, a win here moves DT up into 2nd place. I really feel like DT (the top singles team in F) should be higher already. DT it is, 14-10.
Match #9: (E Div.) Aim For Fame @ Cheap Shots. Fame got a big win over the Corks last week, and now are threatening to climb out of the bottom-two spots. The Cheapies turn the threat away, 13-11.
Match #10: (B Div.) Kids on the Fringe @ Village Idiots. The Idiots could still grab 1st or 2nd. First, they have to avoid one of the most dangerous upset teams in all of RDL. They do, barely. 13-11.

Match #11: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ Darty Sanchez. FIVE teams in C are separated by a total of 1 match and 12 points, and one of them will end in a bottom-2 spot. Every match is critical. Sanchez, 13-11.
Match #12: (G Div.) Throwin' on the Bayou @ Diddler on the Roof. If we end up with an H division next season, this match could end up big in determining who plays where. Bayou shows up! 13-11.
